explanation: Compared against OEIS A208425 (ii): for primes p ≡ 2 (mod 3), Σ_{k<p} a(k) ≡ 2p/C(2(p+1)/3, (p+1)/3) (mod p²). The statement requires that the numerator of the rational difference be divisible by p². That is correct because the binomial denominator is coprime to p for p > 2, its entries being < p. For p = 2 both sides equal 2. Faithful.
